channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Brasil no divã: como as eleições e a Copa mobilizam os sentimentos no país - O Assunto #1759
item.description: The podcast examines how the World Cup and the 2026 elections mobilize collective emotions in Brazil, revealing social divisions and feelings such as euphoria, anger, and belonging. Psychoanalyst Vera Iaconelli analyzes the 'vira-lata complex' and national arrogance, discussing sports grief after Brazil's elimination and the need for the country to confront its historical inequalities through self-reflection.

item.title: EUA decidem na quarta sobre tarifaço ao Brasil; governo Lula aguarda 'dimensão da decisão' para calibrar reação
item.description: The Brazilian government is awaiting the U.S. decision on whether to impose 25% and 12.5% tariffs on Brazilian exports, set for Wednesday (15), to calibrate its response. While preparing for the likely confirmation of the tariffs, the Lula administration believes a modified annex with additional exceptions may be included, due to pressure from 43 U.S. companies reliant on Brazilian imports. If confirmed, Brazil plans to respond with official 'indignation', labeling the move 'unacceptable' and unjustified, arguing that Brazil’s tariff structure already favors U.S. exports.

item.title: Flávio, Augusto do Anjos e reaças: entre desastre e esperança ao menos
item.description: The text discusses Flávio Bolsonaro’s 2026 presidential candidacy, emphasizing his reliance on two letters of support from his father, Jair Bolsonaro, and the lack of backing from parties like União Brasil, PP, and Republicanos. Using literary references to Augusto dos Anjos and Wim Wenders’ film, the author suggests the election is both imminent and distant, with risks of institutional disaster if Flávio wins, stemming from an increasingly radicalized and privatized far-right, even in Freudian terms.

item.title: Lula cumpre agenda em SP nesta segunda-feira
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is carrying out an agenda in São Paulo on Monday, the 13th, with visits to São Caetano do Sul and São José dos Campos, where he will announce initiatives and tour local institutions. The schedule includes a 10 a.m. commitment at the Interior Police Division, reinforcing public security actions. These activities are part of a statewide tour aimed at strengthening ties with regional leaders and presenting federal government proposals.

item.title: Os 4 pontos em comum entre Renan Santos, do Missão, e o argentino Javier Milei
item.description: Renan Santos (Missão), a pre-candidate for president, shares four ideological points with Javier Milei: economic ultra-liberalism (lower taxes and bureaucracy), positioning as an anti-system candidate despite being in a formal party, strong support among voters aged 16–24 (37.9% in polls), and conservatism on social issues, including opposition to the LGBT+ agenda, gender equality, and racial equality policies.

item.title: O custo eleitoral difuso de ignorar a opinião pública sobre a farra das emendas
item.description: Despite 82% of Brazilians associating parliamentary amendments with corruption, according to Genial/Quaest, Congress continues allocating tens of billions via Pix, bench, and individual amendments with opaque criteria. Even after the demise of the 'secret budget,' Lula released a record R$ 34 billion in amendments during an election year, ignoring public demand for technical, transparent use of funds. The lack of electoral accountability for amendment-related scandals perpetuates a cycle where politicians benefit from their base while taxpayers bear the cost of opacity.

item.title: Flávio diz que procurará China para negociar taxa de 55% sobre carnes
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) announced he will seek negotiations with the Chinese government to reverse the 55% tariff on Brazilian beef, which he blames on President Lula. He criticized the federal administration for alleged incompetence in defending Brazil’s trade interests, linking the Chinese measure to Lula’s responsibility. The remarks were made during a live social media broadcast amid rising trade tensions with the U.S., which threatens a 25% tariff on Brazilian goods.

item.title: Valdemar: “Bolsonaro é que tem os votos”
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL, stated that Jair Bolsonaro holds the electoral capital of the right and that his letter strengthens Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential pre-candidacy in 2026. He emphasized that Bolsonaro’s support is decisive to consolidate the bolsonarist ticket.

item.title: “Não aguento mais mineiros enrolados”, diz Cunha sobre emendas
item.description: The Federal Police intercepted dialogues in which former deputy Eduardo Cunha complains about Minas mayors and requests the redirection of a parliamentary amendment from Governador Valadares to another municipality, suggesting irregular allocation of public funds. The messages, exchanged with servant Mariângela Fialek (Tuca), show Cunha directly coordinating the distribution of at least 29 health committee amendments worth R$ 6.1 million. Minister Flávio Dino ordered the blocking of R$ 6.1 million in Cunha’s assets, who is a pre-candidate for the Chamber of Deputies from Minas Gerais.

item.title: Cunha queixou-se de “mineiros enrolados” em diálogo sobre emendas
item.description: Former federal deputy Eduardo Cunha (Republicanos) was intercepted by the Federal Police complaining about 'tangled' miners from Minas Gerais and requesting the redirection of a R$ 6.1 million parliamentary amendment originally intended for Governador Valadares to another municipality, in messages with aide Mariângela Fialek (Tuca). The communications are part of an investigation into alleged irregular allocation of public funds, with the PF stating Cunha directly coordinated the distribution of at least 29 health-related amendments worth R$ 6.1 million. Although Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordered the freezing of R$ 6.1 million in Cunha’s assets, his defense denies wrongdoing and pledges to challenge the ruling.

item.title: Nardoni marca de cabeça e faz 2º gol do Grêmio contra o Cruzeiro no DF
item.description: In a friendly match between Grêmio and Cruzeiro at Arena Mané Garrincha in Brasília, Grêmio won 2-1. The second goal was scored by midfielder Nardoni, who headed in unmarked inside the box after a cross from Pavón in the 37th minute of the first half. The match was broadcast by Metrópoles Sports, which has been promoting various sporting events throughout 2026.

item.title: Republicanos nega que tenha fechado apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro e indica ‘neutralidade’ nas eleições
item.description: The Republicans party denied having closed support for Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential bid, stating that talks with him were inconclusive and occurred over a month ago. Internal surveys show voter frustration with Bolsonaro's pre-candidacy and a preference for neutrality, while support for Lula is completely ruled out. The party's final direction will be decided at its National Convention.

item.title: Lula quer ato em São Bernardo para iniciar campanha
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) is expected to officially launch his 2026 re-election campaign in São Bernardo do Campo (SP), the city where he began his union and political career. The symbolic event aims to reinforce his working-class roots and energize his electoral base.

item.title: Moraes manda soltar PM preso em operação da PF e impõe uso de tornozeleira eletrônica
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes ordered the release of military police officer Antônio Gomes da Silva Neto, replacing preventive detention with electronic monitoring and passport surrender. He also granted house arrest to Senate pre-candidate Márcio Canella under the same conditions and demanded the Rio de Janeiro Military Police explain the origin of two seized firearms within five days. The PF operation, part of Mission Redentor II, targets money laundering through gas stations, with evidence of R$ 7.6 billion moved over six years.

item.title: CBF posta vídeo sobre futuro ciclo da Seleção Brasileira; assista
item.description: The CBF posted a video on social media on July 12, 2026, reflecting on Brazil's elimination from the 2026 World Cup and announcing the start of a new cycle aimed at the 2030 World Cup. The video features emotional images of players like Neymar and Casemiro saying goodbye, as well as young talents such as Endrick, Estêvão, and Raphinha, along with coach Carlo Ancelotti, delivering a message of resilience, hard work, and hope for the future.

item.title: Ayrton Senna é reconhecido oficialmente como Herói da Pátria
item.description: Ayrton Senna was officially recognized as a National Hero with the inclusion of his name in the Book of Heroes and Heroines of the Fatherland, sanctioned by Law No. 15,447/2026, signed by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The three-time Formula 1 world champion, who died in 1994 at age 34, was honored not only for his motorsport achievements but also for the educational work of the Ayrton Senna Institute. The proposal originated from Senator Marcos Pontes (PL-SP) and was approved by Congress before presidential sanction.

item.title: Em vídeo sem camisa na esteira, Lula exibe rotina de exercícios físicos e incentiva cuidados com a saúde
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva shared a video on his social media showing his physical exercise routine, including 40 minutes on a treadmill, with 10 minutes of running at 8 km/h. He noted that he can now perform exercises he couldn’t do in 2003 at age 57, and urged the public to adopt healthy habits, such as daily 20- to 40-minute walks, emphasizing that health is the most important goal to enjoy life with family and pets.

item.title: Marcos Pereira nega vaga ao STF como condição para apoiar Flávio
item.description: Republicans party leader Marcos Pereira denied conditioning the party's support for pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro on a Supreme Court nomination. He stated that the decision on presidential support will be made at the national convention, noting preliminary surveys show frustration with Flávio's pre-candidacy and a preference for neutrality, ruling out support for Lula. Senator Rogério Marinho, Flávio's campaign coordinator, also categorically denied that the party's support is conditional on STF appointments.

item.title: Deputado do PT pede ao STF que Bolsonaro seja transferido para regime fechado e Flávio pague R$ 100 mil de multa após carta
item.description: Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) asked the STF to revoke Jair Bolsonaro's house arrest and transfer him to a closed regime, after the former president had a letter read by his son Flávio Bolsonaro, violating the ban on expressing himself via social media. The petition also seeks a R$100,000 fine against Flávio for 'an act attentive to the dignity of justice'.

item.title: Cunha teve aval da Presidência da Câmara para desviar recursos, diz PF
item.description: The Federal Police found that Chamber employee Mariângela Fialek (Tuca) had full approval from the Presidency of the House to divert R$6.15 million in amendments favoring former deputy Eduardo Cunha, according to a decision by Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino. The funds were directed to municipalities in Minas Gerais, where Cunha plans to run for federal deputy in 2026, and he acted as a 'relevant vector' in defining the allocations, bypassing formal procedures. The investigation reveals a scheme of promiscuity in the secret budget, with messages showing direct coordination between Cunha and Tuca.

item.title: Com Carlos Vinícius, Grêmio está escalado para encarar o Cruzeiro no DF
item.description: Grêmio will face Cruzeiro this Sunday (July 12) at 5 p.m. at Arena Mané Garrincha in Brasília, with Carlos Vinícius starting in attack. The announced lineup includes Gabriel Grando, Pavon, Gustavo Martins, Kannemann (captain), Caio Paulista, Juan Nardoni, Villasanti, Gabriel Mec, Tetê, Amuzu and Carlos Vinícius, with substitutes such as Thiago Beltrame and Gabriel Menegon. The match is part of the Metrópoles Sports project, which has hosted several sporting events in 2026.

item.title: Ouça jingle em homenagem a Lula com aceno a evangélicos
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva shared an evangelical jingle titled 'Tapete Vermelho' on his official Instagram account, composed by Aline Paula (portrayed as AI character Lina Luz), which praises his political journey, including his imprisonment during Operation Lava Jato, international recognition, and Northeastern roots. Lula expressed gratitude for the tribute, noting the video had previously been circulated by the PT and his supporters.

item.title: Servidora teria o aval de Hugo Motta para desviar emendas a Eduardo Cunha, diz PF
item.description: The Federal Police informed Minister Flávio Dino that Congressional employee Mariangela Fialek (‘Tuca’) had the approval of House President Hugo Motta to divert parliamentary amendments in favor of Eduardo Cunha, who, despite holding no office, allegedly acted as a mastermind in redirecting public funds, particularly for his campaign to become a federal deputy from Minas Gerais. The PF described the scheme as a ‘serious deviation of purpose’ involving the secret budget, prompting Dino to order the seizure of up to R$ 6.15 million in Cunha’s assets and the immediate suspension of expenditures tied to the questionable amendments.

item.title: Bloqueio de R$ 6 milhões: Eduardo Cunha já foi preso, cassado e pretende disputar eleição
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordered the blocking of up to R$ 6 million in assets belonging to former Chamber of Deputies president Eduardo Cunha, as part of a Federal Police investigation into alleged corruption and money laundering. Cunha was imprisoned in 2016, expelled from Congress, and declared ineligible by judicial decision, yet he states he intends to run in the 2026 elections. The asset freeze aims to secure payment of potential fines and restitution tied to his confirmed convictions.

item.title: Lindbergh pede revogação da prisão domiciliar de Jair Bolsonaro por carta lida por Flávio
item.description: Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) urged the STF to revoke Jair Bolsonaro's house arrest, claiming that the letter read by Flávio Bolsonaro on social media violates the ex-president's communication restrictions under house arrest. Lindbergh argues the letter — in which Bolsonaro endorses Flávio as his 2026 presidential successor — reveals a strategic shift, turning Flávio into a mere mouthpiece for his father after failing to mobilize Bolsonaro’s base independently.

item.title: Sem fechar apoio a Flávio, Republicanos quer ouvir bases sobre neutralidade
item.description: The Republicanos party denied having closed support for Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign, stating it remains neutral and intends to consult its base before making an official decision.

item.title: Servidora atuava com aval de Motta em esquema de Cunha, diz PF
item.description: The Federal Police indicate that Câmara dos Deputados employee Mariângela Fialek, known as Tuca, acted with the approval of the Chamber’s presidency, led by Hugo Motta, to operationalize parliamentary amendments indicated by former deputy Eduardo Cunha. The investigation suggests a scheme involving the manipulation of public funds through amendments directed by Cunha, with institutional backing from the Chamber’s presidency.

item.title: PF vê "pleno aval" da Presidência da Câmara a emendas de Eduardo Cunha
item.description: The Federal Police told the STF that there are indications the Presidency of the Chamber of Deputies gave full approval to the parliamentary amendments attributed to former deputy Eduardo Cunha, who allegedly uses Chamber staff to direct funds for his political interests in Minas Gerais. Mariângela Fialek (Tuca), a Presidency aide, is identified as operationalizing the scheme, serving under both Arthur Lira and Hugo Motta. Cunha, a pre-candidate for federal deputy in MG, is under investigation for indicating amendments without holding office, leading to the freezing of over R$ 6.1 million in assets by Minister Flávio Dino.

item.title: Caiados chegaram ao poder em Goiás em 1883, sofreram com Vargas e agora miram o Planalto
item.description: The Caiados, a traditional political family from Goiás, came to power in 1883 and faced challenges during Getúlio Vargas’s government. Now, they aim to expand their influence nationally, targeting the Planalto in 2026. The article also references political maneuvers involving Eduardo Cunha and public funds.

item.title: “Não acredito que esse cara seja o Lula”, afirma Cabo Daciolo
item.description: Federal deputy Cabo Daciolo, a presidential pré-candidate for the Mobiliza party, claimed in a YouTube podcast with over 3 million subscribers that he does not believe President Lula is truly who he claims to be, questioning the president's health and suggesting someone else may have assumed his identity. He also reiterated his belief that the 2018 stabbing of Jair Bolsonaro was a staged event that was never properly investigated. Daciolo argued that his past controversial claims—such as about the New World Order, Illuminati, and population reduction—were initially dismissed as madness but later validated by events.

item.title: Obra de megaponte na Bahia começa com pendências em projeto e desafios na engenharia
item.description: Construction of the Salvador-Itaparica megabridge officially began in July 2024 with the activation of a drilling rig off the coast of Vera Cruz, Bahia. The project, first conceived in 2009 and with a contract signed in 2020, was renegotiated in 2025 with a Chinese consortium, but continues to face design delays and engineering challenges.

item.title: “Cruze os braços”, diz líder dos caminhoneiros em recado a Alcolumbre
item.description: Trucker leaders are pressuring Senate President Davi Alcolumbre to bring Provisional Measure 1343, known as the 'Freight MP,' to a vote before it expires on July 16. The measure, issued by President Lula in March, establishes a minimum freight rate for autonomous truckers. Leaders threatened to 'cross their arms' — a euphemism for striking — if the vote does not occur.

item.title: Eduardo Cunha nega irregularidades e contestará bloqueio de bens
item.description: Eduardo Cunha denies irregularities in indicating parliamentary amendments and says he will contest the freeze of R$ 6.1 million in his assets ordered by Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino. His defense argues the amendments were formally submitted by legitimate parliamentarians and that Cunha, lacking a mandate, could not have initiated them. The investigation also involves Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the PL, whose assets over R$ 119 million were blocked for similar alleged misconduct.

item.title: Dino determina bloqueio de 6,1 milhões de Eduardo Cunha por suspeita de desvio de emendas
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordered the blocking of 6.1 million reais from former deputy Eduardo Cunha over suspicions of diverting parliamentary amendments. Investigations allege Cunha acted as a 'relevant vector' in directing public funds despite holding no office since 2016, aided by a Chamber employee. The funds were allegedly funneled informally to Minas Gerais, where Cunha seeks a Senate seat in 2026.

item.title: Dino bloqueia R$ 6,1 mi de Eduardo Cunha em investigação sobre emendas
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordered the blocking of R$6.1 million from former deputy Eduardo Cunha over alleged illegal direction of parliamentary amendments, despite Cunha holding no office, based on evidence he coordinated fund allocations through Chamber employee Mariângela Fialek. The ruling also suspended the execution of the investigated amendments and ordered the Chamber to provide internal documents within 10 days, potentially constituting the crime of embezzlement.

item.title: Carta de Bolsonaro põe em risco prisão domiciliar com recurso do PT ao STF, gera críticas de candidatos e incomoda Michelle Bolsonaro
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro's letter supporting his son Flávio Bolsonaro, shared on social media, drew criticism from pre-candidates like Ronaldo Caiado and Renan Santos, upset Michelle Bolsonaro, and may jeopardize his house arrest, as the PT filed a petition with the STF claiming he deliberately violated Alexandre de Moraes' order by using the measure for political-electoral communication.

item.title: Nunes Marques vai receber representantes de institutos de pesquisa e de big techs no TSE
item.description: TSE President Minister Nunes Marques will meet this week with representatives of polling institutes and social media platforms to discuss rules for voter intention surveys and strategies to combat misinformation, hate speech, and fake news during the 2026 electoral period. The meetings follow the controversial suspension of an AtlasIntel poll on Flávio Bolsonaro, which sparked censorship allegations, and the dismantling of the social media monitoring structure established under Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Mulheres são 3,76% dos pilotos brasileiros
item.description: Women represent only 3.76% of Brazilian pilots, with 1,105 women licensed to fly for airlines, of whom just 235 work for the three major carriers. Despite absolute growth — from 14 licenses in 2005 to 114 in 2025 — female participation has remained nearly stagnant for two decades, below the global average of 4%. Causes include discriminatory barriers, high training costs, and difficulty accumulating required flight hours.

item.title: A ‘tônica’ de Lula com bets, blusinhas e dívidas
item.description: Daniella Marques, former president of Caixa Econômica Federal and responsible for the economic agenda in Flávio Bolsonaro's government plan, accuses the Lula administration of creating problems only to offer solutions afterward, citing the regulation of online betting followed by criticism, the taxation and subsequent removal of taxes on 'blusinhas', and the Desenrola program as examples of a 'tonic' leading the country to an abyss. She argues that the spread of online betting reflects vulnerable Brazilians seeking miraculous solutions to lost purchasing power and insists this issue must be integrated into Flávio Bolsonaro's social mobility agenda.

item.title: PF diz que Presidência da Câmara deu aval para desvio de emendas em nome de Cunha
item.description: The Federal Police state that Chamber of Deputies employee Mariângela Fialek, known as 'Tuca', had 'full approval' from the Presidency of the House to divert amendments in favor of former deputy Eduardo Cunha. The investigation, a spillover from 'Operation Transparency', reveals a parallel decision-making scheme to allocate public funds, with Cunha acting as a key vector despite lacking office. The PF blocked R$ 6 million linked to Cunha and is investigating potential embezzlement, while the Chamber's Presidency has not responded to comment requests.

item.title: PT convoca militância a pressionar Senado por fim da 6 X 1
item.description: National PT president Edinho Silva called on supporters to pressure the Senate to approve the PEC ending the 6X1 work schedule, a government priority in the 2026 election year. Mobilization begins Monday (Jul 13) with a social media campaign, after the proposal passed the Chamber and has been stalled in the Senate since May 28. PT Chamber leader Pedro Uczai labeled Senate President Davi Alcolumbre an 'enemy of workers' if he doesn’t advance the proposal, prompting a rebuttal from Senate government leader Teresa Leitão, who distanced the PT bancada from the comment.

item.title: Marinho nega acordo entre Flávio e Republicanos por vaga no STF
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho, coordinator of Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign, denied any agreement with the Republicans party to nominate its president, Marcos Pereira, for a Supreme Court vacancy. He called the claim 'absolutely false' in a social media statement.

item.title: Investigado por suspeita de desvio de emendas, Eduardo Cunha planeja candidatura a deputado em MG
item.description: Former federal deputy and Chamber of Deputies president Eduardo Cunha is under investigation by the Federal Police for suspected diversion of parliamentary amendments, with Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordering the freezing of R$ 6 million in his assets. Despite prior conviction, cassation, and imprisonment in the Lava Jato operation, Cunha announced his candidacy for federal deputy from Minas Gerais in 2026, describing the state as a 'synthesis of Brazil'.

item.title: Republicanos nega apoio a Flávio e amplia isolamento do senador
item.description: The Republican Party formally denied support for Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) presidential pre-candidacy, rejecting any negotiation for a Supreme Court seat in exchange for backing. The move highlights Bolsonaro’s growing isolation, as parties like União Brasil and PP have also ruled out supporting him. Internally, the party believes Lula would defeat Bolsonaro if elections were held today, and stated its final position will be decided at a national convention, ruling out support for Lula.

item.title: Dino bloqueia R$ 6 milhões de Eduardo Cunha após PF identificar indicação de emendas mesmo sem mandato
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino blocked up to R$ 6.15 million in assets of former congressman Eduardo Cunha after a PF investigation found he, despite lacking a parliamentary mandate since 2016, acted as an 'informal parliamentarian' by directing public amendment funds—particularly to benefit his pre-candidacy for federal deputy from Minas Gerais. The ruling also halted all public expenditures linked to the suspect amendments, with the PF identifying 21 amendments totaling the blocked amount.

item.title: Renan Santos ironiza Flávio após carta de Bolsonaro: “Parece criança”
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Renan Santos (Missão) mocked Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) after he read aloud on social media a letter from former President Jair Bolsonaro declaring him his 'spokesperson' and endorsing his presidential bid. Renan called the gesture 'ridiculous', saying Flávio 'looks like a child who got scolded'.

item.title: Lula faz aceno aos evangélicos e publica jingle gospel
item.description: President Lula (PT) reached out to evangelical voters by publishing the gospel jingle 'Tapete Vermelho' on his official profile, composed and performed by Aline Paula (Lina Luz). His campaign acquired the song's copyrights, planning to use it more frequently in communications targeting this electorate. The post was made on a Sunday, a day of religious worship, as part of a strategy to deepen dialogue and strengthen ties with evangelical families.

item.title: Caiado diz que carta de Bolsonaro mostra 'fragilidade' da candidatura de Flávio
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD’s presidential pre-candidate, criticized Flávio Bolsonaro for suggesting that Jair Bolsonaro’s public letter of support highlights weakness in his son’s candidacy. Caiado argued that reliance on paternal backing reveals a lack of political autonomy and strength. The remarks were made on Saturday, January 11, 2026, amid intensifying debate over succession and alliances within Brazil’s right wing.

item.title: As ausências notadas por Michel Temer no lançamento do filme ‘963 Dias’
item.description: Former President Michel Temer expressed disappointment over the absence of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas and Mayor Ricardo Nunes at the premiere of the film '963 Days', which portrays his presidency. Held in São Paulo, the event gathered politicians, business leaders, and officials, aiming to reframe Temer’s legacy by emphasizing reforms and countering the Workers’ Party’s coup narrative.

item.title: Lula vai evitar pauta de costumes e focar em valores cristãos para atrair evangélicos
item.description: The PT is adopting a strategy to attract evangelical voters by avoiding culture war issues like abortion and same-sex marriage, and framing its social programs as aligned with Christian values. The goal is to reduce Flávio Bolsonaro's advantage among this electorate, whose popularity dropped after his ties to Daniel Vorcaro were revealed. The party aims to position itself as respectful of faith, contrasting with what it accuses the opposition of doing: instrumentalizing religion for political gain.
